items.name: KTX High-Speed Train: Seoul Station to Busan Station
items.claimed_text: 2. Board KTX train 45 miuntes early to secure luggage space. -Takes 2 hours and 45 minutes to get to Busan.
items.claimed_hours: Board 45 minutes early; 2 hours 45 minutes duration
items.verified_location: Seoul Station (405 Hangang-daero, Yongsan-gu, Seoul) to Busan Station (206 Jungang-daero, Dong-gu, Busan)
items.verified_hours: First KTX ~05:13, Last KTX ~22:28 (50+ daily departures; typical duration 2h 17m – 2h 48m)
items.verified_cost: Economy Class: 59,800 KRW (~$43.50 USD) per adult | First Class: 83,700 KRW (~$60.90 USD) per adult
items.transit_from_hotel: Check the departure boards on Seoul Station 2F concourse ~20 minutes before departure; take escalator/elevator down to the assigned track.
items.irregularity_flag: KTX Boarding Rule Discrepancy: Travelers CANNOT board a KTX train 45 minutes early. At Seoul Station, track numbers are posted on the departure board ~20 minutes before departure and KTX train doors open for boarding ~15–20 minutes before departure. Arrive at Seoul Station 30 min early, watch the board, and go down to the platform as soon as the track is posted (15–20 min prior) to place suitcases in the end-of-car luggage racks.

items.verified_hours: Check-in: After 15:00 (3:00 PM) / Check-out: Before 11:00 AM (24/7 Front Desk on 3F)
items.verified_cost: Rooftop Pool (19F) surcharge: 20,000 KRW/adult if not included in room package; Breakfast buffet (2F Floating): 30,000 KRW/adult (07:00–10:00)

items.name: Haeundae Traditional Market (해운대 전통시장)
items.claimed_text: 7. Evening: Walk to Haeundae Market and try Busan street food: hotteok, tteokbokki, mandu, korean fried chicken, and seafood. 8. Go back to the hotel & rest.
items.verified_hours: Daily ~09:00–22:00 (Many seafood/blind-eel & fried chicken stalls stay open until 23:00–24:00; varies by shop)
items.verified_cost: Street snacks (ssiat-hotteok, tteokbokki, mandu) ~2,000–7,000 KRW; fried chicken / seafood ~18,000–45,000 KRW
items.transit_from_hotel: 3-minute walk (250m) east from L7 Haeundae across Gunam-ro.
items.irregularity_flag: Verified. Bring some Korean Won cash for smaller hotteok/snack stalls (sit-down seafood & fried chicken shops accept cards).
